title: M365 Solution Engineer
description:
We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.


The Microsoft 365 Solutions Engineer is responsible for the design, configuration, administration, support, and continuous improvement of the Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity ecosystem. This role will support all core M365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Entra ID, External Entra ID, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Office applications, Microsoft 365 Groups, and related collaboration platforms.


This position will serve as a technical engineer and escalation resource for Microsoft 365 services, ensuring the environment is secure, reliable, scalable, and aligned with business needs. The role will partner closely with global infrastructure, cybersecurity, service desk, application, and business teams to deliver a modern digital workplace experience.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Microsoft 365 Administration \& Engineering**

* Design, implement, and support Microsoft 365 services across a global enterprise.
* Administer Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Manage Microsoft 365 tenant configuration, licensing, governance, and service health.
* Develop and maintain Microsoft 365 architecture standards and operational procedures.
* Lead M365 migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.

**Identity \& Access Management**

* Manage Entra ID (Azure AD), hybrid identity, and Active Directory integrations.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, and identity governance solutions.
* Troubleshoot identity synchronization and authentication issues.
* Support certificate\-based authentication, password less technologies, and smart card initiatives.

**Security \& Compliance**

* Implement Microsoft security technologies including Defender, Purview, and Conditional Access.
* Support data protection, information governance, retention policies, and compliance initiatives.
* Monitor security alerts and collaborate with cybersecurity teams on threat mitigation.
* Participate in security assessments, audits, and remediation activities.

**Collaboration \& Productivity Solutions**

* Support Microsoft Teams collaboration, calling, conferencing, and Teams Rooms environments.
* Configure and manage SharePoint Online sites and governance standards.
* Enable business productivity through Power Automate, Power Apps, Forms, and Copilot technologies.
* Drive user adoption and best practices for Microsoft 365 services.

**Automation \& Optimization**

* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
* Automate user provisioning, licensing, compliance reporting, and administrative tasks.
* Monitor system performance and proactively improve service reliability.
* Create dashboards, reports, and operational metrics related to M365 service delivery.

**Operational Support**

* Serve as a Level 3 escalation resource for complex Microsoft 365 incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Work closely with service desk, infrastructure, and application teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain documentation, knowledge articles, and architectural diagrams.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting:
	+ Exchange Online
	+ Microsoft Teams
	+ SharePoint Online
	+ OneDrive for Business
	+ Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
* Experience with identity management, MFA, Conditional Access, and SSO technologies.
* Knowledge of Microsoft security and compliance capabilities.
* Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and project management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft Copilot and AI\-powered productivity solutions.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview.
* Experience in hybrid cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Teams Rooms and modern workplace technologies.
* Experience supporting global organizations.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Security Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate

**WE HAVE:**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day



	+ nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry\-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
	+ Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com .

	+ We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
	+ Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

* Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

	+ Dedicated to absolute integrity
	+ Focused on the customer first
	+ Respectful and team oriented

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

description:

**Job Description: Storage Administrator (L2 Support)**

We are looking for a talented **Storage Administrator (L2 Support)** to join our IT infrastructure team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for supporting, monitoring, and troubleshooting enterprise storage systems. This role involves addressing escalated issues, assisting with routine storage administration tasks, and ensuring the seamless operation of storage infrastructure in a multi\-vendor environment.


**Key Responsibilities: Storage Administration**

* Manage and monitor storage systems, including SAN, NAS, and object storage platforms, ensuring their health and availability.
* Perform L2\-level support for storage\-related incidents and service requests, including provisioning storage and configuring access.
* Assist with LUN creation, zoning, and masking for storage arrays.

**Issue Resolution and Escalation:**

* Troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex storage issues and escalate critical incidents to L3 support when required.
* Collaborate with L3 teams and vendors to resolve hardware and software issues.

**Monitoring and Reporting:**

* Use monitoring tools (e.g., NetApp on Command, Dell EMC Unisphere, HPE Infosight) to proactively detect and address potential problems.
* Generate and analyses storage performance and capacity reports to support operational planning.

**Maintenance and Upgrades:**

* Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as firmware updates and patch installations, under the guidance of L3 administrators.
* Support storage infrastructure upgrades and migrations by executing defined tasks.

**Documentation and Knowledge Sharing:**

* Maintain and update documentation for storage configurations, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to L1 support teams.

**Qualifications:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Hands\-on experience with enterprise storage platforms from vendors such as:
	+ **NetApp:** ONTAP, SnapMirror.
	+ **Dell EMC:** Unity, PowerStore.
	+ **HPE:** Nimble, 3PAR. Primera
	+ **Hitachi:** E590, E790, E990
	+ **IBM:** FlashSystem.
	+ **Pure Storage:** FlashArray.
* Strong knowledge of storage protocols (Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, CIFS/SMB).
* Familiarity Administrator of SAN switch management (Brocade, **Cisco MDS** ).
* Basic understanding of backup tools and disaster recovery solutions.
* Experience with monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Nagios).

**Experience:**

* 3–5 years of experience in enterprise storage administration or IT infrastructure roles.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve storage\-related issues independently.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes, including Change Management, Service Requests (SRs), and Incident Management (INCs).

**Certifications:**

* Preferred certifications include:
	+ **NetApp:** NCDA or similar.
	+ **Dell EMC:** Proven Professional or equivalent.
	+ **HPE:** ASE or equivalent.
	+ **Brocade/Cisco SAN certifications** (a plus).

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment.

title: Senior Manager, System Operation and Administrator
description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Summary of This Role**
------------------------


Manages the operation, maintenance and administration of the organization's operating and management systems so that they function reliably, meet the organization's business needs, and use the organization's IT resources effectively. Oversees activities relating to technical guidance for planning, directing, and monitoring operating systems. Plans and recommends operating system modifications or additional equipment to increase the capacity of the system. Prepares operational cost estimates for current and proposed plans. Evaluates vendor proposals for purchases of hardware.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

* Provides leadership for all aspects of a global multi\-data center environment. Coordinates the planning, acquisition, implementation, and support of systems deployed globally. Evaluates new technologies for optimal operational value and quality of service. Ensures compliance with regulatory and audit standards set forth by the Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) No.16, Service Organization Controls Report (SOC1\), Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), client contracts and other relevant standards. Ensures system security standards to protect customer data against unauthorized access.
* Plans and directs global capacity management activities to ensure systems are appropriately sized and configured to support customer needs. Establishes and supervises the collection of analytics used for capacity analysis to accurately forecast future resource utilization requirements. Produces annual capacity plan and contribute to budget development, to support required infrastructure enhancements. Ensures scalability and accessibility of applications or services.
* Leads infrastructure change process for a global card authorizations environment. Ensures that change is consistently\-executed, with no interruptions to service. Provides technical leadership of group incident resolution process and root cause analysis. Facilitates large changes and other high\-risk activity. Manages monitoring of other teams' changes when requested.
* Leads the development and support of a disaster recovery and business continuity solution, to support a critical business service. Evaluates new technology to decrease recovery times and simplify recovery solutions. Executes recovery of the production environment to an out of region facility, within contractual time frames.
* Facilitates vendor relationships with major hardware and software providers, including problem management, enhancements, and support. Monitors vendor performance, products, and services. Participates in vendor events which focus on future products and services, industry trends, vendor strategic direction and similar topics. Meets regularly with internal staff to keep apprised of strategic direction and how it would be supported by current and future vendor relationships.
* Collaborates and provides recommendations to executive leadership on technology related issues. Engages global internal business partners to understand their support needs and coordinate the development of infrastructure to maintain relevant services as the payments environment evolves. Communicates effectively with current and prospective clients to align business needs with technical solutions. Coaches team members to effectively engage clients and to provide industry\-best technical solutions.
* Not an exhaustive list; other duties as assigned.

-----------------------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree, Relevant Experience or Degree in: related field of study from an accredited university is required; however, relevant experience in lieu of a degree may be considered.
* Typically a minimum of 8 years related professional experience including a minimum of 3\-4 years experience in a supervisory position.

Exercises full supervision in terms of staffing, work and performance management, salary decisions, training and development, and disciplinary issues.
